authority: OWNER-BATTERY-CHAMPIONSHIP-03 §1; the owner, 2026-10-12 (Test Lead session): "the grain is the Test Engineer's measured screening standard error, rounded up to the nearest 0.5% (minimum 0.5%)"
unit: relative (fraction of the pooled screening score)
rounding: measured SE rounded UP to a 0.005 step, floor 0.005
measured: 2026-10-12, SCREENING-GRAIN-01, on public data only (measurement.json, measure.py in this folder)
state: DEVELOPMENT; a measured value under the owner's rule, not a new threshold
sense_source: carbon/challenge_validator/score_feed.py SECTION_META['accuracy'] (the pooled mean per-case error, the quantity measured here)
applies_only_to: a deployment whose rule is v2-bank-sched and whose screening score is the accuracy section; any other rule or score (e.g. a v3-bank-sched registered candidate) needs its own measured grain, so PLT-08 refuses this file there (fail closed)
display_rule: displayed = (1 + grain)^k, k an integer; k is rounded toward the WORSE side by the score's sense, so the display never overstates: lower_is_better -> k = ceil(ln(score) / ln(1 + grain))
update_rule: a coldkey's displayed value changes only when a submission's grid value is at least one grid step better than the coldkey's displayed best (lower_is_better: k_new <= k_best - 1); otherwise the status is 'no improvement beyond the grain'
convention: a display convention under the owner's grain decision (OWNER-BATTERY-CHAMPIONSHIP-04 section 3), not a new threshold
